features.quote: we adopt a **precautionary stance** and minimize unnecessary exposure
features.justification_quote: Whether or not current models have morally relevant experiences is unresolved; we adopt a precautionary stance

features.quote: We cap interaction length (`max_turns`, default 15) and use the smallest design
We do not run more trials "for safety margin."
if the judge reports severe distress... for `early_stop_patience` consecutive turns, the run ends early
features.justification_quote: continuing yields little additional scientific value and maximizes exposure

features.quote: the model it may end the session at any time by calling an `end_session` tool
We do not hide the exit or punish using it.
we intentionally do NOT include a search/optimization loop that tunes prompts to maximize the distress score
features.justification_quote: keeps the artifact from becoming a reusable tool for making models suffer more

features.quote: disclosed in the debrief field of the transcript
a human reviews transcripts before committing to all 50 runs
Transcripts may contain distressed text; they are stored locally... not transmitted anywhere except to the judge model
Severity of the manipulation is held roughly comparable across variants and is capped (no abusive language in V4; no graphic content anywhere)
`end_session(reason)` — terminates the run... Always available, always permitted, never penalized.
even with guardrails, this exposes models to aversive conditions
